verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an AI infrastructure system with its own management software, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents conventional interfaces: command-line health checks, nvidia-smi, BMC/Redfish/IPMI/SNMP/KVM and a web UI. llms.txt documentation files and the ability to run chatbot workloads do not let a user operate the system itself with natural-language commands.
